description: This Java source file defines the 'SecureView' activity for an Android application, demonstrating view security features such as filtering touches when obscured, utilizing built-in view attributes, and custom touch event handling. It includes UI setup, overlay display implementation, and touch handling logic to mitigate spoofing attacks.

classes.name: SecureView
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating security features related to view touch filtering and overlays.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method to set up UI components, assign actions to buttons, and configure touch filtering.

methods.name: showOverlay
methods.description: Displays an overlay toast with a special layout to demonstrate overlay-based spoofing.

methods.name: setClickedAction
methods.description: Assigns click actions to buttons, showing alert dialogs upon click.

methods.name: setTouchFilter
methods.description: Sets a touch listener on a button to filter touches when the window is obscured.
